triage.test_level_policy: All augmented F2P selectors execute PR-authored flink-tests event-time IT/module tests through DataStream V2 process-function flows, runtime watermark combiners, and watermark handlers. The augmented P2P selector stays in unchanged flink-clients packaged-program behavior. The sidecar files only expose deterministic selector classes and do not call production private helpers.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-output EventTimeProcessFunction running through EventTimeManager timer registration in EventTimeExtensionITCase.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Exercises the provided event-time callback and timer path so the PR must route EventTimeWatermark updates into EventTimeProcessFunction and expose the current event time correctly.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-output EventTimeProcessFunction forwarding event-time watermarks through the generalized watermark output.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the forwarding behavior for provided event-time process functions so event-time extension watermarks are handled by the framework rather than bypassing the event-time callback path.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input broadcast EventTimeProcessFunction receiving event-time watermarks and registering timers.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Forces the two-input broadcast handler to wait for both inputs and advance by the active minimum event time before invoking timer-aware user code.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input broadcast process-function flow with generalized event-time watermark forwarding.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Checks that event-time extension watermarks are recognized and delegated through the framework path for broadcast inputs instead of being forwarded as ordinary watermarks.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input non-broadcast user ProcessFunction handling an EventTimeWatermark.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the user-defined ProcessFunction route where EventTimeExtension.isEventTimeWatermark must recognize the declaration and PEEK must trigger framework event-time processing.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input non-broadcast EventTimeProcessFunction receiving event-time watermarks and registering timers.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Exercises the non-broadcast two-input handler's minimum-event-time and timer-registration behavior through the public event-time process-function contract.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input non-broadcast EventTimeProcessFunction forwarding event-time watermarks.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Covers the non-broadcast forwarding path so extension watermarks are identified and routed through the event-time framework before downstream emission.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension public EVENT_TIME_WATERMARK_DECLARATION and public predicate helpers.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the public event-time watermark declaration to MIN combination, wait-for-all-channel behavior, FORWARD default handling, and event-time predicate recognition.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension public IDLE_STATUS_WATERMARK_DECLARATION and public predicate helpers.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the public idle-status declaration to AND combination, wait-for-all-channel behavior, FORWARD default handling, and idle-status predicate recognition.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder public builder executed through ProcessOperator test harness.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Checks the builder default mode by requiring a periodic event-time watermark after the configured auto-watermark interval.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder noWatermark public builder mode executed through ProcessOperator test harness.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the public noWatermark mode so records and processing-time advances do not emit event-time watermarks.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder periodicWatermark(Duration) public builder mode executed through ProcessOperator test harness.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Requires the user-provided periodic interval to schedule emission rather than falling back to the pipeline default interval.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder withIdleness public builder mode executed through ProcessOperator test harness.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Verifies the builder idleness option emits idle-status true after inactivity and false when records resume.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder withMaxOutOfOrderTime public builder mode executed through ProcessOperator test harness.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Pins the public max-out-of-order tolerance by requiring emitted event-time watermarks to subtract the configured delay from the current maximum timestamp.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 keyed EventTimeProcessFunction using the public EventTimeManager.currentTime method.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Checks the public EventTimeManager currentTime contract from inside an EventTimeProcessFunction callback, requiring it to match the event-time watermark currently being handled.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input non-broadcast EventTimeProcessFunction: only after every input channel supplies an event-time watermark does the combined (min) event time reach the function, which observes it via onEventTimeWatermark and registers event-time timers, all through the public operator output.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Routes to the public two-input non-broadcast event-time receive-and-timer acceptance test, exercising the same all-channels-active combination the removed white-box handler test covered but observed only through the public EventTimeProcessFunction callbacks and operator output.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: DataStream V2 two-input non-broadcast EventTimeProcessFunction: the combined event-time watermark (min across both inputs, waiting for all input channels) advances and is forwarded through the operator's public output; no reliance on the internal EventTimeWatermarkHandler return type.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Routes to the public two-input non-broadcast event-time forwarding acceptance test so a faithful FLIP-499 implementation that advances and forwards the combined event time is scored, without pinning the gold-only EventTimeUpdateStatus/isEventTimeUpdated/getNewEventTime handler internals.

org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.public_surface: EventTimeExtension.newWatermarkGeneratorBuilder public builder declaration contract without idleness enabled.
org.apache.flink.test.streaming.api.data.rationale: Checks that the public event-time builder declares event-time watermarks without requiring idle-status declarations when idleness is not configured, avoiding internal combiner-helper names.

org.apache.flink.client.program.Packaged.public_surface: flink-clients PackagedProgramUtils public packaging and entry-class utility behavior.
org.apache.flink.client.program.Packaged.rationale: Pins unchanged packaged-program behavior in an unrelated client module so FLIP-499 event-time runtime changes cannot mask collateral regressions outside the DataStream watermark surface.

fail_to_pass._summary: 6 EventTimeExtensionITCase tests driving end-to-end DataStream V2 event-time watermark propagation through MiniCluster. Per Flink heuristic §6.2-pre, *ITCase is system-level.

pass_to_pass._summary: 50 untouched flink-clients selectors covering client options, packaged-program utilities, application entrypoint parsing, CLI dynamic properties, frontend info/list handling, and cluster-client service loading. They do not import or compile-depend on generalized-watermark DataStream classes, so they pass in both pre- and post-patch states.

triage.module_scope_rationale: flink-tests hosts the EventTimeExtensionITCase. flink-clients is strict-§7 P2P.
